PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks.
PluginData.Description:
See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks. Sit in a cockpit and type /mg ui. Capture saves a full-health baseline and anchor; local/cloud blueprints can also supply the expected layout.
Yellow means damaged, orange non-functional and pulsing red missing. Customize the HUD, combine system filters, assign shortcuts and save per-ship displays or named baseline revisions.
If the original cockpit is destroyed, Force apply searches surviving blocks and previews an alignment for you to accept. Baselines never update automatically. Reconnect matching is conservative; ambiguous ships may need manual selection.
Station mode is off by default and shows connector-docked grids with matched profiles. Rotor/piston subgrids are excluded. Prototype: new features need in-game testing. /marigold is an alias for /mg.
